text: My daily routine is quite simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a quick shower. After breakfast, I begin work at nine and stay busy until around five in the afternoon. Three times a week, I go to the gym or take a long walk in the park to stay healthy. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a film, or read a book before going to bed. I try to follow the same schedule every day because consistency helps me feel calm, focused, and full of energy.
